description: Defines traits and configurations for mixed GEMM operations on CUDA architectures, including specific traits for Volta, Turing, and Ampere architectures.

classes.name: MixedGemmArchTraits
classes.description: Template struct defining architecture-specific traits for mixed GEMM operations, specialized for different CUDA architectures and data types.

methods.name: MixedGemmArchTraits<float, float, arch>
methods.description: Specialization for float inputs on any architecture, defining stages, operator class, layout, and instruction shape.

methods.name: MixedGemmArchTraits<TypeA, TypeB, cutlass::arch::Sm70>
methods.description: Specialization for half or bfloat16 types on Volta (Sm70), configuring threadblock size, operator class, and instruction shape.

methods.name: MixedGemmArchTraits<TypeA, TypeB, cutlass::arch::Sm75>
methods.description: Specialization for half or bfloat16 types on Turing (Sm75), with specific instruction shape.

methods.name: MixedGemmArchTraits<TypeA, TypeB, cutlass::arch::Sm80>
methods.description: Specialization for half or bfloat16 types on Ampere (Sm80), with specific instruction shape.
